Inner West Council Digital Services Recruitment  

**Application for Senior Integration & Automation Specialist**

Dear Esme,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Integration & Automation Specialist role with Inner West Council. With over 19 years of hands-on technical experience spanning enterprise automation, API and gateway architectures, cross-functional technical leadership, and modern cloud platforms, I am excited by the greenfield opportunity to help shape Council’s new Integration & Automation capability from the ground up.

Throughout my career, I have balanced hands-on technical execution with consultative stakeholder engagement. In my work with Wpay (Woolworths Group), I operated in a dual Business Analyst and Quality Engineer capacity to define user stories, design specifications, and validation strategies for onboarding and licensing gateways, while engineering Azure DevOps pipelines to automate API Gateway regression suites. Previously, at Avant Mutual, I served as QA Lead guiding a technical team through a major platform migration from legacy LAMP architecture to cloud-native .NET and React applications. In that role, I led daily cross-functional triage sessions, aligned business and development stakeholders, and protected data integrity and system quality across complex release cycles.

My technical toolkit includes multi-language automation and scripting across Python, C#, SQL, Java, and UNIX Shell scripting, alongside building robust CI/CD workflows using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions. Furthermore, I hold a Google Cloud Generative AI certification and have designed custom GitHub Copilot SKILLs to automate review workflows and accelerate technical delivery. This background enables me to deliver secure, scalable integration and automation frameworks while exploring pragmatic, emerging AI tooling to improve operational efficiency.

I welcome the opportunity to bring my hands-on automation expertise, architecture background, and collaborative approach to Inner West Council's Digital Services team. I look forward to discussing how my experience can support Council’s digital initiatives and service delivery.

Sincerely,

**Anoop Sinkaran**
